verdict.rationale: Godot's own GitHub README explicitly claims one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms, and licensing docs confirm free commercial use across output platforms, supporting the studio-lead story of one project targeting multiple platforms. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on the console export workflow (which in practice requires partner/licensed console SDKs), and community threads only corroborate desktop/mobile/web export nuances (e.g. C# web export limitations) without independently confirming console export success. Missing for 10: documented partner/console SDK integration process, independent hands-on confirmation of a console export, and detail on how 'via partners' console support actually works in practice.
